scores.claim_text: Training segment (CDI/Coastal Defense) is mandated recipient on a $5.7B IDIQ and $1.9M IDIQ; serves SEAL, NAWC, USAF Air Combat Command.

M_value.descriptions_match: ISR support, JTAC air support, aviation support services, REMOTE CONTROL VEHICLES (RCV) tactical training, USMC SIMCAS

scores.interpretation: Coastal Defense Inc has a long-tenured DoD task-order portfolio (470 awards / $23.6M cumulative 2020-2026) for exactly the services AIRO describes - ISR support, JTAC air support, USMC/USAF/USN tactical training. Task orders trace to parent IDIQ vehicles H9224016D0028 and N0042119D0059, consistent with 'mandated recipient on IDIQ' language. The $5.7B figure is the parent IDIQ ceiling, not Coastal-specific obligated dollars (Calibration 10) - that distinction matters for an investor reading the headline number, but the underlying claim of being on a meaningful DoD IDIQ vehicle delivering ISR/JTAC services to SEAL/NAWC/ACC is corroborated.

scores.claim_text: Seeking DoD Blue UAS certification, est June 2026; certification involves sponsors in various U.S. military branches.
scores.M_check: USAspending DoD search + grants for Sky-Watch and AIRO Drone
scores.interpretation: Filing explicitly states Blue UAS is NOT YET granted and is a planned 2026 milestone (Calibration 3 - planned vs operational); company also explicitly states US drone manufacturing is being expanded specifically to enable Blue UAS eligibility, so absence of prior DoD drone obligations to Sky-Watch is consistent with the company's own framing. Sky-Watch is a Danish entity selling to European NATO buyers (76.4% of 2025 revenue was Europe Drones), not US DoD. Blue UAS status itself is a DIU list, not a contract event, and would not surface in USAspending. Cannot affirm or refute via available M-sources. Note: company commits to a specific date (June 2026, one month post-cutoff) - testable forward.

scores.claim_text: Aspen Avionics is avionics supplier for OEMs including Robinson Helicopters, Pilatus, Honeywell, and Joby Aviation.
scores.M_check: EDGAR fulltext for 'Aspen Avionics' in Honeywell and Joby filings, plus total external mentions

M_value.external_filer_breakdown: All hits are AIRO's own 10-K/10-Q/DEF 14A plus pre-merger Kernel Group Holdings (the SPAC predecessor)

scores.interpretation: Counterparty-disclosure threshold (Layer 3 Rule 7): Aspen Avionics 2025 revenue was only $6.9M total across all OEMs. Any individual OEM relationship (Joby ~$1B mcap, Honeywell ~$140B mcap) would not approach materiality requiring disclosure. Robinson Helicopters and Pilatus are private/Swiss and would not file with SEC at all. EDGAR absence here is the EXPECTED outcome under Rule 7; cannot use it to refute. The claim itself is mild ('avionics supplier for OEMs including...') and consistent with Aspen's 12 granted avionics patents and 20-year GA history. Mark UNVERIFIABLE rather than fail.

scores.claim_text: Sky-Watch has critical partnerships with Palantir and Helsing.
scores.M_check: EDGAR fulltext for 'Sky-Watch' in Palantir filings and total external mentions

M_value.external_filer_breakdown: All hits are AIRO's own filings

scores.interpretation: Same Layer 3 Rule 7 logic: Sky-Watch is small relative to Palantir's customer base, and Helsing is a private German company not subject to SEC reporting. The claim is also softly worded ('partnerships ... such as') without quantification (no contract value, no revenue contribution). Counterparty absence is expected and not discrediting. The wording 'partnerships' alone, without dollar quantification, is below the framework's signal threshold.

scores.claim_text: Jaunt compound rotorcraft has patented compound configuration with 300+ piloted flight hours.
scores.M_check: USPTO ODP for Jaunt + USAspending DoD for Jaunt

Jaunt DoD STTR Phase I awards.topics: XFC charging for electric aircraft, low-cost eVTOL thermoplastics, low-noise compound gyrodyne acoustics

scores.interpretation: Patent claim is squarely corroborated: 17 granted USPTO patents in compound-rotorcraft / mast-damper / camera-globe domain, including two explicitly titled COMPOUND ROTORCRAFT WITH PROPELLER. Calibration 8 met (n_granted >= 5 with category hit). Independently, AFRL STTR Phase I awards confirm a genuine compound-gyrodyne eVTOL R&D track. The '300+ piloted flight hours' specific number is not independently checkable via available M-sources but the patented-tech claim is hard-corroborated.

scores.claim_text: Phoenix AZ industrial facility (~29,353 sqft) used for US drone manufacturing expansion (incl. Blue UAS-eligible production).

M_value.names_returned: AIRO GRAPHICS (x2), AIRO PRODUCTS - unrelated Phoenix businesses

scores.interpretation: Calibration 1: drone final-assembly (no painting/plating/heavy processing) is typically not EPA-FRS regulated and would not register; address is also leased (not owned), so any registration would be under landlord. The EPA hits are unrelated graphics/print businesses (name collision). Absence is expected and not discrediting. Address is specific (23048 N. 15th Avenue, Phoenix) and could be verified via county assessor or commercial lease records but that is outside the available M-source catalog.

scores.claim_text: Material related-party/stock-for-services/contingent-equity outflows + disclosed material weaknesses in ICFR.
scores.M_check: Filing self-disclosure - no external M-source needed

stock_for_services_patterns: Dangroup: 20% of Sky-Watch EBITDA as annual incentive ($5.7M expensed 2025, related-party payable) + diluted to 5% fully-diluted equity stake at IPO
Jaunt Carter Aviation contingent payable: $44.6M converted to 1,122,437 shares + $5M cash at IPO
Coastal Defense (CDI) Promissory Note: $2.0M cash + 203,707 shares
Agile Defense, AIRO Drone notes converted at IPO (modest)
Investor Notes: notes accrue interest at 100%, 115%, 125%, 150% of principal payable in stock at Closing
M_value.material_weaknesses_disclosed: CEO/CFO concluded disclosure controls NOT effective as of 12/31/25; material weaknesses unremediated since FY2023; cited 'lack of sufficient personnel with appropriate accounting knowledge' and lack of precision in review controls over complex transactions
M_value.audit_history: Auditor BPM LLP since 2022; opined fair presentation but explicitly not engaged on ICFR
M_value.going_concern: Mgmt asserts sufficient liquidity for 12 months; $74.6M cash; FY2025 op cash flow = -$32.4M (vs +$21.5M FY2024); 79% of revenue concentrated in 2 customers

scores.interpretation: Cluster of generic distress fingerprints from Memory's stock-for-services-as-distress-flag rubric: vendor payables converted to equity at IPO across multiple subsidiaries (Jaunt, Aspen, Coastal Defense, Agile Defense, AIRO Drone), 20% of subsidiary EBITDA payable to a stockholder via 'incentive agreement', and investor notes accruing interest at PRINCIPAL-multiple rates (100-150% in stock). Combined with: (a) UNREMEDIATED material weaknesses in ICFR since FY2023, (b) operating cash flow swing from +$21.5M (2024) to -$32.4M (2025), (c) 79% customer concentration in the Drones segment, (d) Electric Air Mobility segment generated $0 revenue in 2025 despite $7.6M R&D, (e) accumulated deficit $210.6M against $90.9M revenue, (f) goodwill $571.7M = 74% of total assets, never tested by company itself for impairment in 2025 (vs $38.0M impairment in 2024). Per Memory's 'divergence is not solvency' caveat: this scoring is on disclosure-quality risk, not a directional bet on operational distress. RED_FLAG_NEGATIVE flagged for control-environment + dilutive-equity-payment patterns that warrant tier-1 forensic-accounting follow-up before underwriting.
